display_name: F跨RX50弱发射机：可微临时骨干更新与曝光匹配CE
description: Original F+CROSS_RX50 scratch=33L+17U/RDrop1/oldgate-ownEMA-cos/LS.01/ordinaryAug. Two-arm current-L-only differentiable crossRX meta feature objective versus alpha0. No new head/params/actualoptimizer steps. No satellite; clean only.
authorization: Active user worse-transmitter feature-learning goal; local, no satellite augmentation/test, default head joint. Source feature geometry motivates a generic all-class margin, no target class-specific rule.

code.environment: Verified native Windows base Python3.10/PyTorch2.10+cu128; direct base interpreter; FP32/noTF32

data.representation: Original native received residual/post_sync/noeq, center crop/RMS normalized256 IQ; SAME validated mmap cache; native eq_i/sig_i/base_index restored by opaque physicalID join

roles.L_s: 6300 original visible source labels, randomL128 drop_last; ordinary augmentation; original native two RDrop forwards
roles.U_s: 56700 TX hidden; original U256 and batch_neighbor/ownEMA recipe during17U epochs; no new U feature objective
roles.V: 27000 no_grad defaulthead health plus descriptive actual joint160 source geometry. No V gradient/statistic in training, head fit, prototype classification, or target use.

data.capsule_id: existing VALIDATED_ONCE Phase1 capsule manifest; reuse unchanged
data.split_id: original registered source/target physical split; reuse unchanged

permissions.claim_scope: Frozen default-head ManySig clean target168000 accuracy/MacroF1/perTX/RX/day; exposed benchmark; no independent blind/Phase2/satellite claim

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Existing source READY/EXACT_MATCH manifest reused; original role cache and native temporal metadata, current same-run initialization/source_frozen/native checkpoint args
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Scratch only, own scratch EMA. Reuse matching local BASE scores/source and prior sourceV geometry as references, never as initialized model state. Real BASE checkpoint only for one discarded noquery smoke.

execution.gpu_policy: Physical GPU0 max3 total source/predict workers across owners, freeRAM>=4.5GiB; CPU score max1 across this/current original50 run via CIM; preserve all healthy tasks
execution.launch_command: LOCAL_BASE_PYTHON -X utf8 -u -m experiments.cvs_f_weaktx_metarx50.driver --profile LOCAL_PROFILE --metadata LOCAL_SOURCE_NATIVE_GATE_METADATA_R02 --base LOCAL_RUN/20261020-phase1-FcrossRX-weakTX-metaRX-e50-clean-local-m2-r01 --reference-base LOCAL_RUN/20261019-phase1-FcrossRX-TXrisk-geometry-e50-clean-local-m4-r01 --commit RELEASE_COMMIT --max-workers 3
execution.stop_rule: Role/provenance/config/output conflicts, nonfinite loss/gradient, incomplete native budget/EMA/Sinc/feature scope or failed worker stop new dispatch; preserve outputs and other healthy workers; no automatic or performance-based retries

metric_names: paired seed differences and sampleSD/positive counts
META_RX minus EXTRA_RX_CE same-seed paired differences
Actual extra L feature forwards/inner-gradient norms/virtual held loss change/eligible calls
Source each-weak outRX margin q10 and RXspread/interTXgap; descriptive only
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Frozen same-row final50 default head; reused matching BASE predictions from parent run
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Independent CPU truth-last only after row clean predictions fixed

rows.purpose: Initial paired source falsification; reused matching BASE
rows.seed_notes: Original native model/augmentation and random L/U sampler; fixed original source partition392005; clean evaluation deterministic, no new channel randomness

optimizer.weight_decay: q -= alpha lambda (q+p0/s); AdamW q decay0
optimizer.native_cosine_schedule: Original alpha cosine; one fixed mapping immediately before each actual step

source_feature_objective.descriptor: channel time mean/population std, current L-batch detached standardization floor1e-4, sampleL2 eps1e-4
source_feature_objective.negative: otherTX only; sameTX sameRX excluded in CROSS_RX denominator
source_feature_objective.two_forward_policy: Mean of first/second losses, each mean of shallow/middle; reuse original actual augmented L IQ and RDrop forwards
source_feature_objective.invalid_anchor: Exclude anchors without positive or otherTX negative; finite zero if none; sampler unchanged
source_feature_objective.U: Original oldgate/ownEMA/cos untouched; no U TX labels or added U feature loss

additional_cross_RX_meta.inner_parameters: All identity dimensionless deployed features excluding defaultW and2Sinc q; real Sinc outer training retained
additional_cross_RX_meta.inner_split: one cyclic current source RX, class-balanced all visible L TX
additional_cross_RX_meta.outer_split: other current source RX, fixed weakTX1/3 class-balanced
additional_cross_RX_meta.objective: .5*(inner CE+held CE after virtual feature SGD)
additional_cross_RX_meta.extra_forwards: First actual augmented L128; second held weak subset. Eval, cloned buffers, fresh/restored parameter caches; no main RNG consumption.

notes: Original50=33L+17U/11100updates, RDrop1/ordinaryAug/LS.01/oldgate-ownEMA-cos/unified Sinc/defaultheadjoint. No satellite training; clean168000 only. Max3 total GPU0 workers counting other owners; RAM>=4.5GiB; one CPU scorer.

MLDG reference https://aaai.org/papers/11596-learning-to-generalize-meta-learning-for-domain-generalization/ . This is a feature-only weakTX adaptation, not a canonical reproduction or invention. Prior crossRX credit diagnostics did not backpropagate through virtual updates; here META uses create_graph=True and actual second-order outer feature gradients.

Current actual augmented L128 only, no sourcebank or new IQ read. Rotate RX1/3/4/6/8 each scheduled call. Inner CE balanced across present source TX in anchorRX; outer CE balanced across both fixed weakTX1/3 in otherRX. First eval functional forward uses L128, second heldweak; alpha0 matching exposure/control. Both use detached existing W, cloned buffers and fresh/restored caches; actual mainRDrop/SupCon and joint W training unchanged.

Virtual SGD alpha.01 only dimensionless feature parameters. Both physical Sinc q leaves are unchanged virtually, avoiding mixed units. Actual outer gradients still reach q and unchanged physical-unit AdamW/clip5/origin decay performs the only real update. No inner optimizer state, new head, deployed parameters or persistent virtual weights.

New future source promotion rule is fixed before new target access and does not retrofit prior failed candidates: each weakTX sourceV outRX feature-margin q10 >= same-seed BASE+.002; RXspread/interTXgap <=1.05x BASE; zero features0; defaulthead overall>=-.2pp/worstRX>=-.5pp/anyTX>=-1pp; eligible calls>=99%. Defaulthead source health remains separate from parameter-free geometry.

Baseline geometry reuses prior declared27000 sourceV/3fixedBASE descriptive diagnostic. All these sourceRX were previously seen by the encoder: outRX excludes RX from descriptive centroids, not from all model training. No prototype classifier decisions/accuracy or sourceV gradients/fitted heads. One existing final validation pass collects raw joint160 and defaulthead outcomes.

Initial two seed01 rows source-freeze before any new candidate target. Each arm independently expands unchanged02/03 only from source rule; scientific fail still completes initial clean test. No target tuning, seed selection, selective reruns, or extra reviews/seals. All negative results retained.

Checks PASS8protocol negatives, exact scalar second-order oracle, actual F/main+aux/Sinc/head boundary, state/RNG preservation, warmup/EMA/feature export, CPU andCUDA combined full backward, real matching final50 CP zero-input discarded smoke; zero source/targetIQ reads or optimizer/head updates. One independent P0/P1 review PASS.

Backend original FULL_FP32_NO_TF32/cudnn_deterministic=false retained. Same model/data recipe is not a claim of bitwise cross-process training. Report actual n/paired mean/sampleSD/positive count/perTX/RX/day/cost and tiny n1 limits. Benchmark already exposed: no new blind, Phase2, or satellite claim.
